name: ai-agent-to-google-flow
description: Let your AI agent (or you) generate images in Google Flow in paced, resumable batches through your own signed-in Chrome.

scripts.check: node --check plugins/google-flow/skills/images/scripts/flow.mjs && node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('plugins/google-flow/skills/images/scripts/lib')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'plugins/google-flow/skills/images/scripts/lib/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"

author: Ariantabib
